::: {#def-slr}
#### Simple linear regression model

A **simple linear regression**
[@wikipedia_simple_linear_regression] model
is a linear regression model (@def-linear-regression)
with $p = 1$ covariate $X$,
writing $\predvar_\iobs$ for $\predvar_{\iobs 1}$:

$$\mean(x) \eqdef \intcoef + \coef{x} x.$$
:::
